asr.full_text: Your Mirror Trading international business. Tony Robbins has a saying, if you do what you've always done, you'll get what you've always gotten. However, if you are happy with the status quo of your life, this video is not for you. Sit back and relax, your Bitcoin is growing. We cannot guarantee that the ideas shown in this video will work for you. The ideas and concepts that are shared in this video, are from the experiences of people who have built a business, and ideas that they use to continue to build their businesses. All projections made in this video, are based on current history. It must be noted that all bonuses are dependent on trading results. How much would you like to earn per week, in binary bonuses? How much would you like to earn per week in Binary Bonuses? How much would you like to earn per month? How about earning $50,000 per day? $330,000 per month. In this video you will be shown two different paths, one for the person who has limited time. We will show you a steady track and then the fast track approach for the person who desires financial freedom, and has a burning desire to accomplish their dreams quickly. Whichever path suits you, remember that success becomes predictable when you are consistent. In networking, there are generally four types of people. The Highly Effective The Motivated The Average Members And The Novices the highly effective, the motivated, the average members, and the novices. On the table you can see the types of recruiting results each of these types of people will get. The highly effective people will generally share the business with someone every day. They'll recruit approximately 10 people per month, usually finding 2 motivated people, four members, and 4 novices. The motivated share the business every other day and this results in them recruiting about five new people per month. They have a good chance of finding one motivated person like themselves, two members and two novices. Members on the other hand will share the business about eight times a month and recruit about three new people. The results are typically one new member like themselves and two novices. Novices usually recruit their family members initially, and then find other novice people like themselves. Let us now look at the typical results that can be achieved by a motivated person over a period of 12 months. 6 months number of team members in weca leg, 76. Average member position in US dollars, $200. Potential binary bonus per week $106. 12 months, number of team members in week a leg, 2,309. Average member position in US dollars, $200. Potential binary bonus per week, $3,232. Let us now look at some typical results that can be achieved by an average member over a period of 12 months. 6 months Number of team members in weaker leg 36 Average Member Position in US$200 Potential binary bonus per week fifty one dollars 12 months number of team members in a week a leg 516 average member position in us dollars 200 dollars potential binary bonus per week 722 dollars here is a comparison between the steady and fast track with monthly Binary bonus projections added. You will see from this comparison that over time your team will grow. The more effort you are able to put into growing your business the quicker you will achieve financial freedom. For more information on how the Binary bonuses are calculated please refer to the Binary Bonus videos. Here is an example of what can be achieved. This was achieved in 6 months by a highly effective leader in Mirror Trading International. What about $360,000 per month? Once you have reached the 12 month fast track goal, then the maximum earnings will be 24 to 36 months away. How can teamwork benefit you? then the maximum earnings will be 24 to 36 months away. How can team work benefit you? The first example is spillover. However it is not guaranteed. Spillover happens when your sponsor or someone in the team above you places someone in the leg beneath you. But don't count on spillover until it actually occurs. Merit Trading International provides you with educational videos and other support material to assist you in building your business. The videos can be found on the dedicated YouTube channel and in the back office. Other information and education material are shared regularly on the WhatsApp groups. Please use these tools to your advantage. Working with your sponsor can be a great way to accelerate your success. Reach out to them and get as many Tips as you can from them. If you are on social media, use it to your advantage. Post regularly on your favourite channels like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn & Twitter. Funnel systems are also effective for gathering leads, if you are prepared to pay for the promotion of these on Facebook Mirror Trading International is your business It is up to you to turn possibilities into success If you have questions or for more information please contact Clint

visual.observation: A presentation table models a network structure with categories including "Recruited," "Member," and "Novice," and shows corresponding "Weekly Binary Bonus" and "Monthly Binary Bonus" amounts in later comparison slides.

visual.potential_relevance: The displayed bonus amounts are quantitatively connected to a network structure that includes recruited members, so the relationship between recruitment and promised returns may merit review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish that viewers were asked to recruit, that the projections were achieved, or that any payment or loss occurred.

visual.observation: The video displays high earnings projections, including "$15000 per day" and "$330,000 per month," and later provides a WhatsApp number and email address under "QUESTIONS" alongside Mirror Trading International branding.
visual.context: The contact information is presented as a questions/contact route, and the organization name and logo are visibly repeated; the frames do not state that the contact route is required to obtain the earnings.
visual.potential_relevance: Substantial earnings claims are shown in the same presentation as a direct WhatsApp/email contact route for the branded business, creating a reward-and-contact relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish who controls the contact accounts, whether the earnings are attainable, whether money or data is requested, or whether viewers acted on the information.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Mirror Trading International through recruitment-dependent earning projections, presenting team growth and binary bonuses as a path to financial freedom, including claims such as $330,000 per month. It instructs viewers to recruit others, use sponsors and social media, and contact the promoter, so the disclaimers do not change the video's central solicitation of participation in a multi-level earning structure.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted earnings are explicitly tied to recruiting a downline, team-member growth, sponsor spillover, and binary-leg qualification rather than to an ordinary one-level referral.
